formalizations.note: All fifty-nine listed declarations are sorry-free Lean 4. Audited headline axiom closures contain only propext, Classical.choice, and Quot.sound. This milestone proves that the common boundary map is based-nullhomotopic and reduces chain descent to the alternating face sum.
